## Summary

A concise description of the proposed feature.

## Motivation

Why is this feature useful? What problem does it solve? Are there existing workarounds?

## Proposed approach

How should this work? If you have a specific design in mind, describe it. If you have alternatives,
include them.

## Safety impact

Does this feature touch any safety invariant (NO-MONEY-OUT, honest-green ship gate, keystone
invariant, fail-closed defaults)? If yes, how is safety preserved?

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches were considered, and why was this one chosen?

## Additional context

Any other context, screenshots, or references.
